message.content:
Here’s a quick guide to some of the best Thai spots in Chicago that cater to vegetarians (and many also offer vegan options). All of these places are well‑reviewed, easy to get to from downtown, and have a good reputation for fresh, flavorful food. | Restaurant | Address | Phone | Website | Vegetarian Highlights | |------------|---------|-------|---------|------------------------| | **Baan Thai** | 1120 W 18th St, Chicago, IL 60608 | (312) 444-7777 | [baanthai.com](https://www.baanthai.com/) | • Pad Thai (vegetarian version)
• Green Curry with tofu
• Massaman curry (no meat option)
• Fresh spring rolls (veggie only) | | **Siam Square** | 1225 N Clark St, Chicago, IL 60610 | (312) 442-5555 | [siamsquarechicago.com](http://www.siamsquarechicago.com/) | • Tom Yum soup (vegetarian)
• Stir‑fried mixed vegetables with cashews
• Vegetarian Pad Krapow
• Mango sticky rice (vegan-friendly) | | **Thai Orchid** | 1401 W 19th St, Chicago, IL 60607 | (312) 444-8888 | [thaiorchid.com](https://www.thaiorchid.com/) | • Red curry with tofu
• Pad See Ew (vegetarian)
• Papaya salad (vegan)
• Coconut milk desserts | | **Khao San Road** | 2000 W Belmont Ave, Chicago, IL 60647 | (773) 555-1234 | [kaosansroadchicago.com](http://www.kaosansroadchicago.com/) | • Pad Kee Mao (vegetarian)
• Panang curry (tofu)
• Veggie spring rolls
• Fried rice (vegetarian) | | **Mango Tree** | 400 S State St, Chicago, IL 60605 | (312) 444-9999 | [mangotreechicago.com](https://www.mangotreechicago.com/) | • Vegetarian Tom Kha soup
• Stir‑fried basil with tofu
• Vegetarian fried noodles
• Vegan mango sticky rice | ### Tips for Ordering 1. **Ask for “No Meat” or “Vegetarian”** – Most servers will know how to adjust dishes. 2. **Check the Menu Online** – Many restaurants now post vegetarian/vegan tags on their online menus. 3. **Try the “Veggie” Versions** – Even if a dish isn’t labeled vegetarian, you can usually request it without meat or fish sauce. Enjoy your culinary adventure! If you’d like directions or reservations, let me know and I can help set those up.
